description: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE of the kye.surface_affordance_contract.v1 shape — not a source of truth. The live contract is the registry kye:registry:surface-affordance-contract, which the engagement-coverage gate reads; this file shows the minimum well-formed instance — one obligated kind, one exempt kind with its reason stated, and the enforcement binding. Canonical artefacts are referenced here by registry id rather than by repository path: a public example must not name an IP-track location (§33), and an id is the stable reference anyway (§0.9).

affordance_vocabulary.control: A page-owned button, input, select or textarea.
affordance_vocabulary.form: A page-owned form the reader can submit.
affordance_vocabulary.behaviour_script: A page-specific behaviour script that is not canonical chrome.

kinds.rationale: A landing has to let the reader do the thing it claims, not only read that the thing can be done.
Deliberately exempt — a glossary is read by lookup and the canonical search palette already supplies that affordance at chrome level.

enforcement.contract: Every discoverable page satisfies its kind's affordance obligation, measured from page_owned{} in the §50 page manifest.

measurement_note: Obligations are measured against page_owned{}, never raw elements{} — the latter includes canonical chrome and would pass the great majority of the estate without opening a single page.
